parrafo.es: Zachary Pritz construye chimeneas a medida, instala molduras, repara siding y resuelve arreglos del hogar en Gainesville. Trabajo directo con el dueño, sin intermediarios y sin dejarte a medias.
parrafo.en: Zachary Pritz builds custom fireplace surrounds, installs crown molding, repairs siding and handles home repairs around Gainesville. Direct work with the owner, no middlemen, never left halfway.

hero.imagen_alt: Custom stacked-stone fireplace surround with wood mantel built by Pritz Custom Carpentry

parrafo_1.es: Zachary Pritz es el dueño y el carpintero detrás de cada proyecto. Clientes destacan que es honesto, puntual y que da estimados razonables antes de empezar, sin sorpresas al final.
parrafo_1.en: Zachary Pritz is the owner and the carpenter behind every job. Clients note he is honest, punctual, and gives a reasonable estimate before starting, with no surprises at the end.

parrafo_2.es: Va más allá de lo acordado: una clienta cuenta que volvió un fin de semana para instalar una pieza de repuesto, y otro cliente lo vio trabajar bajo sol de 100 grados hasta terminar bien el trabajo.
parrafo_2.en: He goes beyond what is asked: one client said he came back on a weekend to install a replacement fixture, and another watched him work through 100 degree heat until the job was done right.

texto.es: Nos llamas o escribes y nos cuentas qué necesitas: una chimenea, molduras, siding o un arreglo puntual. Respondemos directo, sin formularios.
texto.en: Call or message us and tell us what you need: a fireplace, trim work, siding or a quick repair. We respond directly, no forms.

texto.es: Zachary visita tu casa, mide y confirma materiales y alcance antes de darte un estimado razonable.
texto.en: Zachary visits your home, takes measurements and confirms materials and scope before giving you a reasonable estimate.

texto.es: Trabajo detallado y puntual, tratando tu casa como propia, aunque el clima o el alcance se compliquen.
texto.en: Detailed, punctual work, treating your home like his own, even when the weather or the scope gets complicated.

texto.es: Revisamos juntos el resultado terminado antes de dar el trabajo por cerrado, y seguimos disponibles si algo necesita un ajuste.
texto.en: We walk through the finished result together before calling the job done, and stay available if anything needs a follow-up fix.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el alcance. Llama o escribe y te damos una estimación sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on scope. Call or message us and we will give you a no-obligation estimate.

texto.es: Chimeneas a medida, muebles empotrados y piezas hechas a pedido, desde la estructura hasta el acabado final.
texto.en: Custom fireplace surrounds, built-ins and made-to-order pieces, from the framing stage to the final finish.

texto.es: Molduras en gabinetes, techos tipo tray y pasillos, con acabados limpios y bien rematados.
texto.en: Crown molding on cabinets, tray ceilings and hallways, with clean, properly finished corners.

texto.es: Reemplazo de siding agrietado o dañado en el exterior de tu casa, trabajando con el mismo cuidado aunque las condiciones sean duras.
texto.en: Replacing cracked or damaged siding on the outside of your home, with the same care even when conditions are tough.

texto.es: Instalación de luminarias, candelabros y arreglos generales del hogar, resueltos sin dejarte a medias.
texto.en: Light fixture and chandelier installs, plus general home repairs, finished without leaving you halfway through.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu proyecto en la lista? Llámanos igual, seguramente podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Do not see your project on the list? Call us anyway, chances are we can help.

items.quote: Pritz Custom Carpentry provides top notch quality craftsmanship at a reasonable cost. Zachary Pritz is honest and punctual. He is a great guy to deal with. He did a crown molding job for us that turned out amazing. Highly recommend!!

We recently had Zachary replace and fill in the old fluorescent fixture in our kitchen, and we could not be more pleased with the result and his service! Not only did he provide a very reasonable estimate, but he also went above and beyond in terms of service. (The initial fixture didn't work, and he came back out on the weekend to install the new fixture.) I cannot recommend him enough and will definitely be using him for other work around our house!

Zachary was absolutely amazing to work with! He tackle the job of replacing cracked siding on my house in August in 100 degree heat. He also took the liberty to tackle other minor things he can across. Zachary's work was very detail oriented and was completely on time and far beyond what I expected. I will definitely be calling him back in the future for any other needs we have. Thank you so much Zachary, my wife and I are very grateful to found you.
